title: p95/p99 latency ledger and anomaly swimlane per route×model×region
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: provide a unified "latency ledger" and an anomaly swimlane visualization that tracks rolling p95 and p99 latency per route, model, and region, correlated with tokens/sec and KV-cache hit-rate. Background: existing percentile dashboards show static slices but lack temporal cohort views and an automated regression watcher tied to our load harness. This ticket implements (1) an ingestion path for fine-grained quantile samples from the bench harness and production telemetry, (2) a storage-friendly ledger (compact rolling windows) that preserves recent dense history and sparse long-term summaries, and (3) an interactive swimlane + ledger UI that surfaces anomalous cohorts and suspected regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Backend emits p95 and p99 rollups per (route, model, region, hour, cohort) and tokens/sec per minute into the telemetry store. 2) Swimlane UI renders heatmap of p95/p99 deviations for any route/model/region over selectable windows (1h-30d) with hover-to-drill into sample traces. 3) Regression watcher triggers Slack + creates ENG ticket when p95 or p99 exceeds historical baseline by configurable relative delta for >10 minutes. 4) Bench harness (loadsmith) can replay failing cohort to reproduce. 5) End-to-end performance overhead <5% on ingestion sidecar.
notes: Implementation sketch: use a change-point–aware rolling estimator (robust quantile sketch) to reduce storage; emit both deterministic rollups (percentiles) and reservoir samples for forensic replay. Cohorts: prompt token bucket, sequence length bracket, KV-cache-hit boolean, model-variant. Use swimlane coloring based on statistically significant z-score over baseline window. Provide links to rerun bench via loadsmith with prepackaged payloads and a job template in CI. Monitor tokens/sec and attach to swimlane as stacked sparkline.
